header.description: FAM-25 character half (frmMain PasteCharacter, PasteInventoryManager, PasteSpells, ApplyPastedStat, PastedStatIsBuffed; modMMudFunc TestPasteChar, TestAlphaChar) over the stock database.
notes: Procedures are cut from frmMain.frm (scenario key frm). The paste dialog lines are replaced through subs: the pasted text is frmMain.txtClip.Text and the dialog always ends with Continue. Me.Enabled lines are dropped.

VB6 raises a combo's Click and a text box's Change only when the value really changes; the cut code assigns ListIndex and Text through subs that call the real cmbEquip_Click, cmbGlobalRace_Click, cmbGlobalClass_Click (both indexes) and txtCharStats_Change only in that case. Refresh-only handlers are stubs.

SaveCharacter is recorded as an event (success); FileExists is true for a name ending .mmec without 'missing'; FormIsLoaded sees the case's loaded_forms; LoadCharacter, RefreshAll and the list sort/colour are no-ops, so the Item Manager rows are in insertion order (the sort call is dropped from PasteInventoryManager; the port reports it as sort_after).
A case's msgbox lists the answers in the order MME shows boxes (every box takes one, information boxes too); inputbox lists the answers to InputBox. Boxes and handled errors are in events.
